[[Vanquisher|Vanquish]] the [[Morostav Trail]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Clear the Morostav Trail in the [[Echovald Forest]] of all enemies in [[hard mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 15,000 [[Experience]]
* 2,000 [[Gold]]
* 10,000 [[Kurzick Faction]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 250 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].

== Dialogues ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
; [[Zaishen Vanquish]]
: ''"Clear the Morostav Trail in the Echovald Forest of all enemies in hard mode."''
